trainer/30463.htm.text: Master Ixia: Welcome to this holy temple, filled with the energy of Shilen. You have observed that we are shunned wherever we go, viewed with fear and suspicion. Only by strengthening our power can we preserve our race and protect our heritage.

trainer/30463-noteach.htm.text: Master Ixia: I am a Master who teaches Dark Elven Fighters to impose Shilen's will upon the world. I have nothing to teach you, so please look elsewhere.

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30463-01.html.text: Master Ixia: Belladonna? Of course I can make it for you. But first I need a few things. I need Medusa's Blood, Marsh Spider Fluids, Dead Seeker Dung, Tyrant's Blood, and Nightshade Root . Please bring 10 of each . You will find the Dead Seeker bat at the Execution Grounds in Dion, Tyrant in the Wa…

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30463-03.html.text: Master Ixia: You have found all the materials. Please wait as I create the Belladonna for you. You must be very careful! Belladonna is a strong poison. Just one drop will kill even a mighty bull! Here it is. Put it to good use.

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30463-04.html.text: Master Ixia: I won't ask what the Belladonna is for. Don't underestimate its power, just one single drop will turn his body into a corpse and send his spirit back to Shilen.

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30463-05.html.text: Master Ixia: Magister Kaira tells me that you are in the midst of a trial to advance to a higher rank... Does the Belladonna that I made for you the other day have anything to do with that? Anyway, I wish you good luck.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
